value.tagline: A republic on the brink - fragile coalitions, economic crisis and political violence in the year before the 1980 coup, balanced between secular Kemalism and rising religious and nationalist movements.
value.descriptor: A parliamentary republic where a Prime Minister governs at the confidence of a 450-seat National Assembly and a 184-seat Senate, amid the unstable AP/CHP coalitions of the late 1970s.

1953-default.tagline: Menderes's Democrat Party republic — a unicameral Grand National Assembly, NATO membership since 1952, and deepening secular–conservative rivalry.
